title: Moonlight Courier
text: A gentle science fiction comedy about a courier delivering letters across space. The tone is optimistic. Friendship develops between a pilot and the courier. This story contains no horror. It is suitable for a viewer looking for light science fiction humor rather than a tense survival thriller.

title: The Last Platform
text: A tense urban mystery about a missing passenger and a detective. The story focuses on dark suspense, crime and unreliable witnesses. This is not a light comedy. Its central question is why a commuter vanished from a crowded railway platform.

title: Weekend Table
text: A warm family comedy about siblings cooking together during a weekend reunion. Light humor and friendship shape the story. The main conflict is whether the siblings can recreate their grandmother's recipe while learning to cooperate.

title: Red Orbit
text: An intense science fiction horror story on an isolated space station. Survival, fear and darkness are central. A crew tries to understand a mysterious signal while its life support fails. This is intended for a viewer seeking tension rather than gentle comedy.
